title: BARMM chief names Islamic adviser to boost moral governance drive

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Bangsamoro Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua has created the Office of the Senior Adviser to the Chief Minister (OSACM) to provide expert advice and recommendation to the government on matters concerning religious and interfaith affairs, moral governance, policy, and administration. Macacua issued Executive Order No. 10 on Friday creating the the OSACM which will be directly under the Office of the Chief Minister and will serve as a high-level strategic advisory body to assist him in strengthening the policies and programs of the Bangsamoro Government.
